batches.c: Brownfield polygon intersection is a site-screening signal; inclusion is not planning permission and exact current polygon/record binding is required.
Site allocation geometry can be highly relevant to growth, but exact current allocation/policy record and plan status must be resolved before promotion.
Opportunity Area membership is strategic growth context, not parcel permission; exact boundary and current status are required.
Town-centre boundary membership affects policy context but exact centre boundary and proposal/use relationship are required.
Housing Zone membership is programme/context evidence, not current site capacity or permission.
Intensification geography is strategic and cannot be transferred into a parcel score without exact boundary and applicable policy status.
CAZ membership is an exact strategic geography test, but proposal-specific policy consequences still require current policy binding.
SHLAA evidence identifies potential capacity at strategic/site level; it is not allocation or permission and exact site identity is required.
MCIL geography is a charge-context input only; exact site, chargeable floorspace, relief/exemption and effective schedule are required.

batches.t: Site of Importance for Nature Conservation
batches.c: SINC is a mapped nature-conservation designation; exact polygon intersection and designation status are required.
SSSI geometry is authoritative strategic mapping context; exact current site relation and proposal pathway are required.
Conservation-area membership requires exact polygon intersection and current designation status.
SIL membership is a significant industrial-policy signal; exact current boundary and policy status are required.
LSIS is local industrial-policy geography; exact site boundary and current plan status must be preserved.
Wharf safeguarding is exact asset/policy geography; nearby location alone is not a parcel constraint.
Green Belt must be resolved by exact current boundary; borough-level presence or context mapping is insufficient.
MOL must be resolved by exact current polygon and applicable London/local plan policy.
Other open-space mapping is a screening layer; exact designation type and policy effect are required.
Protected-vista mapping is a view-management screening signal; exact corridor/setting geometry plus scheme height/massing are required.
Mapped listed-building records require exact asset/setting relation; point or polygon proximity alone is not a candidate constraint.
Ancient woodland mapping requires exact current woodland/site relation and direct/indirect impact assessment.
Mayor-level Thames Policy Area membership is strategic policy geography and requires exact site intersection plus current policy effect.
Scheduled monument mapping requires exact asset/setting relation and current designation record.
Critical Drainage Area membership is drainage-risk context; exact current boundary and site drainage assessment are required.
AQFA membership is strategic air-quality context, not a parcel emissions outcome; exact location and proposal baseline are required.
Official downloadable Local Plan GIS layers prepare exact spatial crosschecks for the Enfield sample; proposed/emerging layers must not be treated as adopted by default.
CSV/GeoJSON/GPKG conservation-area data support exact polygon matching for the Enfield candidate, with current designation status retained.
CSV/GeoJSON/GPKG TPO data support exact tree/area matching; dataset geometry must not replace the legal order document where precise legal effect matters.
The statutory planning register includes map search and application history; exact property/application record is required before using development history.

batches.t: Enfield interactive Local Plan proposals map
batches.c: Interactive GIS policy mapping is query-ready context; adopted versus emerging/proposed status must be separated before site conclusions.
Aurora exposes property/planning boundaries for map inspection; exact property/application link is required before promoting planning history.
Aurora exposes conservation areas and TPO information; exact highlighted geometry/record must be captured and legal source checked.
BLR identifies suitable/available/achievable housing-led brownfield sites, but Part 1 inclusion is not permission and displayed boundaries are not definitive.
The 2021 Local Plan and Policies Map remain adopted; exact policy-map relationship is required and current EA flood mapping overrides stale plan-map flood context.
Dedicated searches cover applications and decisions since 1990 and appeals since 2003; exact property/reference match is required.
The official Brownfield Land Register polygon layer supports advanced JSON/GeoJSON queries; exact candidate intersection and current record are required.
The official conservation-area polygon service supports advanced queries; exact polygon intersection and current designation record are required.
The official Article 4 service is available as FeatureServer/MapServer; exact direction boundary and operative direction scope are required.
The official Key Industrial and Business Areas service supports site-level industrial-policy screening; exact polygon and current plan status are required.

batches.t: Lambeth Development Management Applications ArcGIS service
batches.c: The official development-management application service can support exact planning-history preparation; application geometry/record and status must be matched.
